name: Fatima Al-Sayed

strengths: Solid Python and SQL for data processing and service integration

resumeText: Fatima Al-Sayed is a Data Engineer at Lumen Health with four years of experience, the first two in backend development at Quicksilver Payments. She now owns Python-based ingestion services and Kafka streams that move healthcare data into BigQuery. Her focus is reliable data movement; she is expanding into distributed processing and warehouse modeling.
